scope: Pinned producer source review and isolated dep-info grammar differential only; not source inventory, compiler binary authenticity, or coverage qualification.
source_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of raw UTF-8 source bytes from each immutable official URL, without normalization
identical_section_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 substring beginning at start marker and ending before end marker, with surrounding whitespace stripped
nightly_collection_differences: Source-map filename collection now calls prefer_local_unconditionally instead of prefer_local.
Optional source checksums use unnormalized_source_len rather than normalized source_len.
Explicit tracked paths use direct to_string_lossy conversion rather than FileName::prefer_local.

native_validation.command: TFM_DEPINFO_NATIVE_TESTS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -W error -m unittest discover -s crates/transformers/scripts/tests -p test_coverage_dependencies.py -v
native_validation.emission: metadata and dep-info only, in isolated temporary directories
cases: Spaces in source/module/include/output paths; present/absent environment values containing spaces, hash, dollar, equals, backslash, newline and carriage return.
A literal hash in an included filename is emitted raw and rejected.
A literal dollar in an included filename is emitted raw and rejected.
A literal backslash in an included filename is emitted raw and rejected.

unchanged_limitations: Only the two exact release/commit/LLVM triples are supported; an alias alone is not a pin.
Continuations are a synthetic-tested restricted extension, not observed native line wrapping.
Non-UTF-8, Windows/colon paths, ambiguous filename punctuation, unsupported Make syntax and nightly checksum comments fail closed.
No arbitrary untracked macro filesystem I/O, path resolution, source exclusion or gate behavior is qualified.
